title: 26 U.S.C. 461, General rule for taxable year of deduction (U.S. Code 2024 edition)
issuer: U.S. Government Publishing Office, United States Code

passages.question: Can an estimate be deducted before economic performance?
passages.excerpt: in determining whether an amount has been incurred with respect to any item during any taxable year, the all events test shall not be treated as met any earlier than when economic performance with respect to such item occurs.
